title: The merge tool sets CLAUDE_SETTINGS_DIR to its own checkout for each pinned run and each repo's readyChecks
why: Gap 1 (runner 9, coordinator 00:15 CST Nov 8): q_max's merge.readyChecks "Type check" runs `npm run lint`, which needs a claude-settings clone at the pinned sha; q_max's harness/pinned-settings.mjs looks only in /root/claude-settings and /root/.claude, so in a cloud session (/home/user/claude-settings) the draft step refuses every q_max batch unless CLAUDE_SETTINGS_DIR is set by hand. Gap 2 (#1417 review note settings-dir-two-pins, coordinator 00:03 CST Nov 8): an inherited CLAUDE_SETTINGS_DIR under two pins reaches any action that reads it.
note: Fix: the merge tool sets CLAUDE_SETTINGS_DIR to its own checkout (the pin it runs) when it runs a repo's readyChecks or a pinned check, in the one place that builds that run; red case first for each gap. Queue fix, so the item 384 hold lets it start (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7: a found gap gets a fix). Folds the #1417 note settings-dir-two-pins, moved here from the outbox. Slug from the coordinator; title by triage. Filed 00:19 CST Nov 8.
